product.title: Key West Tiki Bar Boat to Popular Sand Bar with Turquoise Waters

description.text: Getting out on the water is one of the best ways to explore Key West, but many big tours cram their boats with passengers. This private tour promises an un-crowded experience. Head out onto turquoise water aboard a unique tiki bar boat and look out for marine life such as turtles and dolphins as you cruise to a sandbar where you can swim or just soak up the sun.Private boat tour of Key West: Avoid the big boats Set sail aboard a distinctive tiki bar boat: Unique experience Learn all about the local area and marine life from your captain Includes time for swimming or chilling on the sandbar Ideal for travelers basing in Key West who want a guided Florida Keys experience without coordinating boats, gear, or launch times on their own.
